Dynamic array of player addresses; also used as randomness source.
Mutable pseudo-random seed derived from keccak256 and block.timestamp.
Fixed payout amount of 0.1 ether.
Privileged function to transfer ownership, gated by onlyBy(owner).
Internal RNG using keccak256(playerPool, seed, now); timestamp dependent.
Payable entry that validates 0.1 ether and pushes msg.sender into playerPool.
Private draw: picks winner, transfers funds before clearing state.
Owner-only payable loop refunding players in playerPool.
Owner-only routine calling refund then selfdestruct.
Payable fallback replicating buyIn without return value.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership init and player registration.
Miner-influenceable timestamp (now) feeding the RNG.
External Ether transfer to the winner before playerPool is cleared.
External transfer of entire contract balance to owner inside selectWinner.
External transfer inside the refund loop prior to pool reset.
Irreversible destruction of the contract sending remaining balance to owner.
Weak, timestamp-dependent randomness generation.

edges.reason: Owner privilege is bound to the deploying msg.sender.
_newOwner is written into the owner state variable.
changeOwner mutates the privileged owner variable.
Caller address is pushed into playerPool.
buyIn appends the caller to the player pool.
Fallback appends the caller to the player pool.
buyIn triggers selectWinner when pool length reaches 11.
Fallback triggers selectWinner when pool length reaches 11.
block.timestamp feeds the internal random routine.
Timestamp is consumed by the seed keccak256 computation.
random performs the timestamp-based seed assignment.
random writes the derived value into seed.
Existing seed is reused inside the pseudo-random hash.
random reads playerPool length and last element.
selectWinner calls random to pick an index.
Winner is paid before playerPool state is reset.
Full balance is transferred out before the pool is cleared.
Local winner address is the recipient of the payout transfer.
amount constant is the value sent to the winner.
External transfer can re-enter selectWinner before state cleanup.
Balance transfer to owner is an external call performed pre-cleanup.
close invokes refund before self destructing.
close ends by selfdestructing to owner.
Refund loop performs external transfers before resetting playerPool.
Loop index i addresses the player being refunded.
Each refund transfer is an external call re-entering the loop context.
buyIn depends on msg.sender and msg.value supplied by the caller.
Fallback depends on caller-supplied msg.sender and msg.value.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is only used inside changeOwner when assigning owner.
_account belongs to the onlyBy modifier guarding the privileged changeOwner path.
upper is only consumed as the modulo bound inside random.
i exists solely as the refund loop index over playerPool.
winner is a transient local computed and paid out inside selectWinner.
